Question: Do you allow AI tools to access your email or cloud drives?
Do you paste or upload client/business confidential data into AI tools?
Are you aware whether the AI tool stores your prompts/outputs and where?
Do you avoid entering passwords, OTPs, or API keys into AI tools?
Do you check your prompts for sensitive PII (like Aadhaar,PAN,SSN) before hitting enter?
Do you upload contracts, financial reports or legal docs into public AI tools?
Have you granted AI plugins or browser extensions “read all site data” access?
Do you fact-check AI outputs before sending them to colleagues or clients?
Do you reuse the same password for AI accounts and other online services?
Have you checked if the free AI app you use earns money by selling your data or prompts?
